metadata.title: SolidWorks CAD Part Operations — feature-tree solid modeling layer
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the SolidWorks part-modeling environment. SolidWorks parts are feature-tree-based: every solid feature consumes a sketch (or another feature) and contributes geometry to the consumed body. This catalog covers 30 operations spanning the four sweep families (Extrude / Revolve / Sweep / Loft, each with boss + cut variants — 8 ops), Boundary surface→solid, the Hole Wizard (5 hole types × 5 termination modes folded into one op), apply features (Rib / Dome / Indent / Flex / Thicken — 5 ops), modify features (Fillet / Chamfer / Shell / Draft — 4 ops), patterns (Linear / Circular / Curve-Driven / Sketch-Driven / Table-Driven / Fill — 6 ops), Mirror, and body operations (Move/Copy / Scale / Combine / Split — 4 ops). Bindings target SolidWorks API IFeatureManager (FeatureExtrusion3 / FeatureRevolve2 / FeatureSweep / FeatureLoft / etc.) and IModelDoc2 body operations.
metadata.source: SolidWorks 2024 API Help — Features; SolidWorks API Reference — IFeatureManager / IFeature / IBody2; SolidWorks Hole Wizard standards (ANSI / DIN / ISO)

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across SolidWorks part operations

EXTRUDE_BOSS.description: Extrude a sketch profile into a solid boss. Direction supports 8 termination modes (blind / through_all / up_to_next / up_to_vertex / up_to_surface / offset_from_surface / up_to_body / mid_plane). Optional draft and thin-feature toggles.

parameters.name: Sketch
parameters.description: Profile sketch (must be closed unless thin_feature is true)

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: Required when end_condition is blind / mid_plane / offset_from_surface

parameters.name: Thin Feature Thickness
parameters.description: Optional thin-feature wall thickness; 0 = solid feature

parameters.name: Merge Result
parameters.description: Merge with existing bodies in the part

EXTRUDE_CUT.description: Cut material from a body by extruding a sketch. Same termination semantics as EXTRUDE_BOSS. Flip Side To Cut toggles whether the cut keeps the inside or outside of the closed profile.

parameters.name: Flip Side To Cut
parameters.description: Invert which side of the closed profile is cut

REVOLVE_BOSS.description: Revolve a sketch profile around an axis to create a solid of revolution. Type controls one-direction / mid-plane / two-direction sweep. Thin-feature variant produces a thin-walled revolve.

parameters.name: Axis
parameters.description: Centerline / edge / sketch line to revolve around

REVOLVE_CUT.description: Revolve cut — removes material in a swept revolution. Mirrors REVOLVE_BOSS semantics with Flip Side To Cut for ambiguous closed profiles.

SWEEP_BOSS.description: Sweep a profile sketch along a path curve. Twist control supports none / specified-degree / follow-path. Profile orientation modes control how the profile rotates relative to the path tangent frame.

parameters.name: Tangent To Adjacent Faces
parameters.description: Maintain tangent continuity at start/end of sweep

parameters.name: Merge Tangent Faces
parameters.description: Smooth tangent face transitions in the resulting body

SWEEP_CUT.description: Sweep cut — removes material along a swept path. Useful for rifling, threads, splines, helical coolant grooves.

LOFT_BOSS.description: Loft a sequence of profile sketches optionally guided by guide curves. Start and end constraint modes (default / normal / tangent / curvature) control continuity into adjacent geometry.

parameters.name: Profiles
parameters.description: Ordered array of 2+ profile sketches or planar faces

parameters.name: Guide Curves
parameters.description: Optional array of guide curves controlling cross-profile shape

parameters.name: Close Loft
parameters.description: Close back to the first profile

LOFT_CUT.description: Loft cut — removes material along a lofted body shape. Same constraint vocabulary as LOFT_BOSS.

BOUNDARY.description: Boundary feature — creates a solid (or surface, then thickened) bounded by a network of direction-1 and direction-2 curves. Per-direction tangency control supports none / normal / tangent / curvature continuity into adjacent surfaces.

parameters.name: Direction1 Trim By Direction2
parameters.description: Trim direction-1 curves at direction-2 boundaries

HOLE_WIZARD.description: Insert a parametric hole driven by a hardware standard. Hole Type selects the family (simple / counterbore / countersink / threaded tap / tapered pipe). Standard chooses the hardware reference book (ANSI inch / ANSI metric / DIN / ISO / JIS / KS / GB). Size names a specific entry within the standard. End Condition controls how the hole terminates downward.

parameters.name: Position 2D
parameters.description: 2D position(s) on the sketch plane (single or array for multi-hole)

RIB.description: Add a rib (stiffener) feature — extends a sketch profile until it intersects the existing body. Direction toggles parallel-to-sketch (rib material grows in plane) vs normal-to-sketch (rib material grows perpendicular to plane). Used for cast-part bosses and panel reinforcement.

DOME.description: Create a dome on a planar or non-planar face. Direction = face_normal (default) or specified_axis. Continuous keeps tangent continuity with adjacent faces; elliptical_dome biases the dome toward an elliptical profile.

parameters.name: Continuous
parameters.description: Maintain tangent continuity with adjacent faces

parameters.name: Elliptical Dome
parameters.description: Generate an elliptical-profile dome rather than spherical

INDENT.description: Indent — emboss / impress one body into another. Target body receives the impression; tool body is the indenter. Thickness adds material to the target around the impression; Clearance is the offset between target and tool.

parameters.name: Thickness
parameters.description: Wall thickness added to target around the impression

parameters.name: Clearance
parameters.description: Offset between target and tool surfaces

FLEX.description: Flex feature — globally deforms a body via bend / twist / taper / stretch. Trim planes bound the affected region. Magnitude controls the deformation amount (angle for bend/twist, scale for taper, distance for stretch).

parameters.name: Trim Plane 1
parameters.description: Lower bound of the affected region

parameters.name: Trim Plane 2
parameters.description: Upper bound of the affected region

THICKEN.description: Thicken a surface body into a solid by offsetting one or both sides. Direction selects the offset side (side1 / side2 / both). Optional merge_result blends with adjacent solids.

FILLET.description: Round one or more edges or faces. Fillet Type controls the topology: constant radius, variable radius (per-vertex control), face-face (between non-adjacent faces), or full-round (3 face chain). Multi-radius overrides allow per-edge size variation.

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Default radius for constant / variable fillets

parameters.name: Keep Features
parameters.description: Preserve adjacent features that the fillet would otherwise consume

CHAMFER.description: Bevel one or more edges or faces. Three primary parameterizations (angle_distance / distance_distance / equal_distance) plus offset_distance and face_face. Flip Direction toggles which of the two distances applies to which face.

SHELL.description: Hollow a solid body to a target wall thickness. Faces To Remove become open holes in the resulting shell. Outward inverts the offset direction (default = inward toward the body interior). Multi-thickness overrides allow per-face thickness variation.

parameters.name: Faces To Remove
parameters.description: Faces removed (left open) in the resulting shell

parameters.name: Merge Resulting Face
parameters.description: Merge adjacent shell-result faces sharing tangent continuity

DRAFT.description: Apply a draft angle to faces — required for moldability and casting release. Draft Type selects the reference scheme: neutral_plane (faces drafted away from a reference plane), parting_line (faces drafted away from a curve on the body), or step (multi-step parting line for complex molds).

parameters.name: Parting Lines
parameters.description: Curves on body for parting_line / step modes

LINEAR_PATTERN.description: Pattern features along one or two linear directions. Direction-1 reference, spacing, and count are required; direction-2 makes a 2D grid. Vary Sketch lets the patterned feature reshape per instance based on a parametric sketch driver. Skip Instances suppresses individual indices.

parameters.name: Direction1 Reference
parameters.description: Edge / axis / linear sketch entity defining direction-1

parameters.name: Direction2 Reference
parameters.description: Optional second direction for a 2D grid

parameters.name: Vary Sketch
parameters.description: Re-evaluate the seed sketch per instance using its parametric drivers

CIRCULAR_PATTERN.description: Pattern features around a rotation axis. Equal Spacing distributes count instances over a 360° arc; Specified mode honors the angle and count independently.

parameters.name: Axis Reference
parameters.description: Rotation axis (sketch line / edge / axis feature)

parameters.name: Angle
parameters.description: Total sweep angle (specified mode) or 360 default (equal_spacing)

CURVE_DRIVEN_PATTERN.description: Pattern features along an arbitrary curve. Alignment Method controls whether instances rotate to follow the curve tangent or remain aligned to the seed orientation. Equal Spacing distributes count instances along the curve length.

parameters.name: Transform Curve
parameters.description: Apply curve-tangent rotation to each instance

parameters.name: Equal Spacing
parameters.description: Distribute equally along curve length (false = use Spacing param)

parameters.name: Spacing
parameters.description: Distance between instances when Equal Spacing is false

SKETCH_DRIVEN_PATTERN.description: Pattern features at locations defined by sketch points. The reference sketch point anchors the seed; every other point in the sketch produces an instance.

parameters.name: Reference Sketch Point
parameters.description: Anchor point that maps to the seed feature location

TABLE_DRIVEN_PATTERN.description: Pattern features at coordinates loaded from a CSV / Excel table. Useful for pre-existing drilling charts and PCB-style hole grids.

parameters.name: Transformation Seed
parameters.description: Reference point on seed feature that the table entries position

FILL_PATTERN.description: Tile a region (planar face / closed sketch) with a repeating instance using one of 5 layouts: perforated grid, circular, square, polygon, or custom. Used for vent grilles, perforated plates, and decorative fills.

parameters.name: Region Boundary
parameters.description: Planar face or closed sketch loop

parameters.name: Seed Feature
parameters.description: Feature to repeat across the region

parameters.name: Instance Count Target
parameters.description: Optional target count (overrides spacing if set)

MIRROR_FEATURE.description: Mirror features (or bodies / faces) about a planar reference. Geometry-Pattern-Only mode skips the feature-tree replication and creates a pure copy of the resulting geometry — faster but loses parametric link to the seed.

parameters.name: Mirror Plane
parameters.description: Planar face / reference plane to mirror about

parameters.name: Geometry Pattern Only
parameters.description: Skip parametric tree mirroring (geometry-only copy — faster)

parameters.name: Propagate Visual Properties
parameters.description: Copy materials / colors / display states to mirror

MOVE_COPY_BODY.description: Translate / rotate / copy one or more bodies in the feature tree. Transform Type selects the operation. By Constraints uses mate-style references (point coincident, axis aligned, etc.) instead of explicit coordinates.

parameters.name: By Constraints
parameters.description: Use mate-style references rather than explicit transform values

SCALE_BODY.description: Uniformly or non-uniformly scale one or more bodies. Scale About sets the fixed point (centroid / origin / coordinate system). Uniform Scaling applies a single factor across all axes; otherwise per-axis factors are honored.

parameters.name: Scale Factor X
parameters.description: Scale factor on X axis (or all axes when uniform)

parameters.name: Scale Factor Y
parameters.description: Scale factor on Y axis (non-uniform mode)

parameters.name: Scale Factor Z
parameters.description: Scale factor on Z axis (non-uniform mode)

parameters.name: Uniform Scaling
parameters.description: Apply Scale Factor X to all axes (overrides Y/Z)

COMBINE_BODIES.description: Boolean-combine multiple bodies in a multi-body part. Operation = add (union), subtract (main minus tools), or common (intersection). Keep Main retains the un-modified main body alongside the result.

parameters.name: Main Body
parameters.description: Primary body (subtracted from / unioned to / intersected with)

parameters.name: Tool Bodies
parameters.description: Bodies operated against the main body

parameters.name: Keep Main
parameters.description: Retain the un-modified main body in the part alongside the result

SPLIT_BODY.description: Split a body into multiple bodies using planes / sketches / surfaces as trim tools. Resulting Bodies To Keep selects which fragments survive in the part. Consume Cut Bodies removes fragments not selected for retention.

parameters.name: Trim Tools
parameters.description: Planes / sketches / surfaces used to cut the body

parameters.name: Consume Cut Bodies
parameters.description: Remove non-selected fragments from the part
